title: GTOSD preflop blueprint game configuration
description: Declarative Short Deck preflop game for the vector CFR blueprint solver. Dead antes for every player, one live button blind posted by the BTN, live commitment targets for the first raise and its index-matched re-raise or pot-relative sizes for the first raise (preflop_open_sizes_basis_points, MonkerSolver trees), variable-length postflop size lists, an optional rake (percentage, cap, no flop no drop, minimum pot). Cross-field constraints (strictly increasing targets, response above open, positions ending with BTN) are enforced by the C++ loader.

preflop_open_sizes_basis_points.description: Pot mode: the first raise is sized in percent of the pot, so there is no open target and no re-raise target (the answer to the raise is fold, call or all-in).

open_target_units.description: Live commitment targets of the first raise, strictly increasing; empty exactly when preflop_open_sizes_basis_points is set.

limp_response_target_units.description: Optional. Index-matched re-raise targets for the response to a raise made in a limped pot. Absent means the branch reuses response_target_units; an empty array leaves only fold, call and all-in.

preflop_open_sizes_basis_points.description: Optional (pot mode, MonkerSolver trees). Sizes of the first raise of the hand (open, isolation over limpers, BTN raise over limps) in basis points of the pot after the call, strictly increasing: raise to = current bet + size x (pot + call), dead antes in the pot (10000 = pot raise). Requires open_target_units [] and response_target_units []; the answer to the raise is fold, call or all-in. Absent means the live targets of open_target_units.

postflop_donk_bets.description: Optional. false removes donk bets: before any bet on a postflop street a player cannot bet into the last aggressor of the previous round who acts later. Absent means true.

postflop_all_in_max_pot_basis_points.description: Optional. Largest postflop all-in in basis points of the pot (50000 = 5x): the all-in is offered only when the chips it adds above the call are at most this fraction of the pot after the call (boundary included). A size whose bet reaches the stack still becomes the all-in. Preflop is not affected. Absent means an all-in at every postflop decision.

rake_mode.description: "enabled" requires the four rake_* keys; "disabled" forbids them.

rake_basis_points.description: Rake percentage of the called pot in basis points (500 = 5 %), rounded half up to the unit.

rake_cap_units.description: Largest rake of one hand, in units (1 ante = 10000 units).

rake_no_flop_no_drop.description: true: a hand that ends before the flop is dealt (a preflop fold) is not raked. A called preflop all-in and a checkdown leaf see the flop and are raked.

rake_minimum_pot_units.description: Pots below this amount are not raked; 0 rakes every pot.
